summary: ```markdown # New Baby & Kid Avatar Assets | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive ## Introduction Hey everyone, it's Phoebe here, and I have some great updates to share with you regarding our avatars, kid avatars, and baby avatars. So let's dive on in and have some fun while we learn! ## New Avatars Overview As you can see, I've got a lot of cute little munchkins here. They're so adorable! You can see Baby River going through all of his different ages, along with our classic baby, Juju. ## New Poses and Ages What you can see is that these are all some of the new poses and ages that are now available in CLO. You can find all of this in our library. ### Accessing the Library At the top corner of your screen, this little icon will pull up your library. You can already see some new kid poses. If you go to just the CLO assets, you can see a whole baby section here featuring Juju. ### Poses and Accessories You can see some of the new poses available for you to use. Of course, we've got some accessories like hair and shoes—fun accessories that aren't really that new. You can also go to our connect assets, where you can find even more poses for all of our baby assets. This allows you to create really great little scenes, which will be really fun! ## Baby and Kid Avatar Range ### Baby River Ages For our kids, Baby River goes from three months all the way to 24 months. You can also see Avery and Sasha, along with Melody and Oliver, who range all the way up to six years. ### Age and Size Categories You can see babies that are six to 18 months old, as well as sizes for two to six years. This includes options for both girls and boys, along with all of these poses. ## Connect Assets Library If you go to our connect asset section, you can again see more kid poses and all of that information neatly organized for you. There are also motion-related accessories, including hair and shoes. ### Exploring the Connect Library Additionally, there’s more in the connect library that you can scroll through and use. There is a lot of really great stuff for you to explore now in CLO and connect. ## Conclusion So check them all out! Make a fun scene like this one and watch your baby go through all of its stages. Thanks so much for watching! If you have any questions, use that comment section down below. Bye bye! Don't forget to like and subscribe. Check out the CLO YouTube channel for tons of great videos and information. Thanks again, and keep having fun in CLO! ```
